newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Swiss gsa Sky Reps forms Brussels airport unit.
newsitem.headline: Swiss gsa Sky Reps forms Brussels airport unit.

text.p: Sky Reps Aviation, a Swiss general sales agent said it has setup a Brussels based company,Sky Reps Aviation bvba.
Major clients of the company include Lauda Air and Air Gabon, it added.
The company's Brussels manager, Tilly Serrao, said customer demand and the country's good transport links to the rest of Europe are behind the move.
Sky Reps Aviation already has offices in Germany, Italy and Switzerland.

The Swiss company has previously worked for Air Gabon but only out of Switzerland . The African company flies ex-Paris four times a week with a Boeing 747 combi to Libreville and it also serves other African destinations including Johannesburg, Dakar and Abidjan.
Another of the major customer is Austria's Lauda Air which was previously the client of VIA, a Dutch general sales agent.
Lauda operates twice-daily flights between Brussels and Vienna. These flights have a daily capacity of around a tonne from Belgium although there also departures from Paris as well.
Air Malawi operates weekly flights out of London and cargo is trucked between Brussels and London.

Sky Reps also represents several CIS airlines such as Air Georgia, Armenia Airlines, Belavia, Kirchistan Airlines, Riga Airlines and Ukraine Air Services. Other customers include Yemenia, Air Madagascar and Royal Brunei. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
